lineage.program: TTT-Hybrid-Lab independent exploratory lane; no FORGE, Wingless, Yggdrasil or Hybrid runtime modifications

research_question: Can a model use continuous sensory/action/consequence streams to identify previously unseen physical dynamics and predict counterfactual interventions without a tokenizer, vocabulary, symbolic key-value IDs, segmented linguistic units, or a next-token loss?

numerical_input.source: sampled numerical sensor observations and actuator values; not unbroken mathematical time; digital sampling remains

arms.description: GRU(4 continuous measurements,32 state units) with non-token 2-parameter physical readout, trained end-to-end using MSE of future consequence
Strong conventional recursive least-squares adaptive two-parameter physical estimator; sees same continuous sensor/action history, no cross-world training
Negative control: replace 32 context measurements with an unrelated world, keep original intervention queries and targets
Ground truth dynamics known to evaluator, never supplied to learning agents

training.training_target: continuous x_next intervention consequence; not tokens

evaluation.holdout_split: NEW, different from local development seeds 137,257,389 and 541,601,701; these new seeds not executed before this protocol was committed

classification.trained_gru_pass: TRAINABLE_CONTINUOUS_GRU_ADAPTATION_SIGNAL only if GRU passes both ID and OOD adaptation tests on ALL three independent training seeds
classification.trained_gru_fail: ANALOG_RLS_PASS_GRU_TRANSFER_NULL_OR_NEGATIVE; preserve RLS outcome and GRU negative as separate evidence
classification.originality_note: RLS and GRU are established techniques. This first test is a tokenization-free representation and action-consequence feasibility baseline, not a novel intelligence mechanism or proof of reasoning.

stop_conditions: RLS positive or swapped-history negative control fails
